highlights: New warp system: charge the drive and rocket forward at 5x speed in a straight line. Green button next to the mining one (E key on PC).
You can zoom out much further now to see the map at a larger scale.
The options button is now a gear icon, bottom-right.
Fixed the engine trail, which was coming out of the ship's side instead of behind it.
Cleaner ship art for the full catalog — no visible change to the ship you're currently using.
Fixed reconnection — it used to always fail after minimizing the game on mobile, now it retries when you come back.
Fixed the menu and mining buttons drifting out of place when zooming out.
Fixed the ship jittering when zoomed in.
New blue plasma trail on the ship's engine.
New flight physics: your ship now has real inertia — it turns gradually and drifts a bit when turning sharply at high speed, instead of changing direction instantly.
Free movement in any direction, no longer just 8 fixed directions.
Fixed pinch-to-zoom — it wasn't working correctly on mobile before.
New patch notes screen on startup, highlighting what matters in each version.
Zoom with mouse wheel (PC) or pinch (mobile).
The game now supports multiple languages — pick yours from the options menu.
Text and window sizing adjustments so it looks good on any screen.
The Ship Codex is now an editor: change any ship's name, stats, sprite, or sound.
Changes can be exported and applied to the live game.
First real ships in the game, with engine sound.
New Ship Codex tool to browse the 41-ship catalog.
Much smoother movement with multiple players at once.
New character creation/selection screen (up to 5).
Ping indicator and automatic reconnect if the connection drops.
Visible border for the playable world.
Full touch controls: a joystick appears wherever you tap, plus a mining button.
Options menu with a button to close the game.
Fixed a bug that stopped ships from visibly moving.
First playable version: fly your ship, mine asteroids, and play with others in real time.
